camel_example: aliyun csas UpdateVirusScanGlobalConfig --region cn-hangzhou --UploadFileMaxSpeed 1024 --UploadFileSuffixBlacklist.1 doc --UploadFileMaxSize 10240 --VirusFileUpload true --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the anti-virus global configuration for the current Alibaba Cloud account. The four configuration items are treated as a whole and are entirely overwritten with each call. Therefore, pass in the complete configuration with each call: set VirusFileUpload to false, UploadFileSuffixBlacklist to empty, and UploadFileMaxSize and UploadFileMaxSpeed to 0 (no limit). After VirusFileUpload is changed, the virus file upload module switch is synchronously updated, which affects whether cloud-based STS tokens are issued to user terminal devices
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号的防病毒全局配置。四项配置为一个整体，每次调用都会整体覆盖，因此每次调用都需要传入完整配置：VirusFileUpload按false、UploadFileSuffixBlacklist按空、UploadFileMaxSize与UploadFileMaxSpeed按0（即不限制）写入。VirusFileUpload变更后会同步更新病毒文件上传模块开关，影响是否向用户终端设备签发云查STS Token
kebab_example: aliyun csas update-virus-scan-global-config --virus-file-upload true --upload-file-suffix-blacklist doc --upload-file-max-size 10240 --upload-file-max-speed 1024 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirusScanGlobalConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether user terminal devices are allowed to upload detected virus files to the cloud for further analysis. Valid values:
true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许用户终端设备将检出的病毒文件上传到云端用于进一步分析。取值：
true：允许上传。
false：不允许上传
parameters.name: virus_file_upload

parameters.help_en: The collection of file types that are prohibited from being uploaded. Duplicate values are not allowed. Files that match the specified types are not uploaded even if upload is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 禁止上传的文件类型集合，不允许重复。命中的文件即使开启上传也不会上传
parameters.name: upload_file_suffix_blacklist

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of a single virus file that can be uploaded. Unit: KB. Valid values: 0 to 204800. A value of 0 indicates no size limit. Values from 1 to 204800 specify the actual size limit
parameters.help_zh: 单个病毒文件允许上传的大小上限，单位为KB。取值范围：0~204800，其中0表示不限制大小，1~204800为具体的大小上限
parameters.name: upload_file_max_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum upload rate for virus files. Unit: KB/s. Valid values: 0 to 102400. A value of 0 indicates no rate limit
parameters.help_zh: 病毒文件上传的速率上限，单位为KB/s。取值范围：0~102400，其中0表示不限速
parameters.name: upload_file_max_speed
